content:
Maria (CS): Heads up — QBR with Meridian next Thurs 10am PT. Need final deck by Tue EOD. 
Maria (CS): Ask list: slide owners, 1-line renewal signal (green/amber/red + why), demo owner + a recorded fallback in case their private VPC blocks live access. Also want top 3 onboarding blockers and a single ask for execs.
Jules (CS Manager): I can own onboarding health slide. Will add health score, 3 blockers (data mapping, SSO cert, token expiries) and current mitigation plan.
Noah (Eng): Can add a micro-latency chart, but I need last 30-day traces from Console (per-route view). Grant me access to meridian-prod?
Maria (CS): @Noah yes — sent dashboard invite just now.
Alex (SE): I'll own the demo. I'll record a 3-min fallback walkthrough that hits the Dedicated endpoint and shows failover to hosted. ETA Mon noon. Link when ready.
Sam (PM): Request: include a single-product roadmap bullet about batching optimizations (1 slide, 1 sentence). I can draft.
Jules (CS Manager): Also flag renewal signal as AMBER — customer usage plateauing and a couple of unresolved onboarding blockers. Adding a recommended exec ask: commit to a 2-week dedicated SRE pairing to unblock SSO.
Noah (Eng): Quick note — the latency numbers will look different in their VPC (we sample on redwood-side). I can add a short note on measurement variance.
Alex (SE): Recording done: https://loom.example/meridian-qbr-fallback (recorded demo + step-by-step). Also uploaded a short fallback runbook excerpt.
Maria (CS): Nice — please paste the fallback runbook snippet into the deck speaker notes.
Alex (SE): Done. snippet:
```
If private VPC demo fails: 1) Switch to hosted model via console -> models -> select redwood-hosted; 2) Run canned prompt; 3) Share session link with execs.
```
Deploy Bot: Deployment to staging completed: infra/batching-v0.9 at 2025-11-02T19:08Z :rocket:
Sam (PM): Thanks — will add roadmap bullet and 1-sentence impact line.
Jules (CS Manager): Slide owners recap: onboarding health (Jules), renewal signal + exec ask (Maria/Jules), demo (Alex), latency note (Noah), roadmap bullet (Sam).
Maria (CS): Action items: everyone add slides to deck by Tue EOD; Alex paste loom + runbook into speaker notes; Noah add latency note + attach traces; Sam add roadmap one-liner; Jules finalize health slide and the ask. I'll consolidate and send final for review Wed morning.
Noah (Eng): Ping me if you need a stripped-down trace export, can script it.
Alex (SE): Also prepping a 30s clip of the failover for the opening.
Jules (CS Manager): Marking renewal risk AMBER in CRM and adding tasks for the SRE pairing.
Maria (CS): Perfect. If anything blocks, call a 15-min dry run Wed 4pm. :thumbsup:
Sam (PM): +1
Noah (Eng): +1
Alex (SE): I'll be there.
Maria (CS): Thanks team — moving to action.
